Question: For each positive integer \(m \gt 1,\) let \(P(m)\) denote the greatest prime factor of \(m.\) For how many positive integers \(n\) is it true that both \(P(n) = \sqrt{n}\) and \(P(n + 48) = \sqrt{n + 48}?\)
